title: Add release team
author: christian-rauch
body:
* Name of the new release team: `open3d`
* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [open3d](https://github.com/christian-rauch/open3d_colcon.git)
    * https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/47284
    * https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/76411b71a540fca944856506d9595e506d6c32a7/rolling/distribution.yaml#L4855-L4859
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: <RELEASE REPOSITORY URL>

* Team members
  * [@christian-rauch](https://github.com/christian-rauch/open3d_colcon/blob/4f04b27be86425495d8bc49934f34e97e3ab2897/package.xml#L7)

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
Hi @christian-rauch before we can create release repositories for a project it needs to undergo ROS package naming review and [indexing](https://docs.ros.org/en/jazzy/How-To-Guides/Releasing/Index-Your-Packages.html) in https://github.com/ros/rosdistro

Since this looks like a vendor package you might also be able to make use of [ament_cmake_vendor_package](https://github.com/ament/ament_cmake/tree/rolling/ament_cmake_vendor_package) which will help the package conform to our vendoring conventions.

comments.author: christian-rauch
comments.body: @nuclearsandwich The `open3d_vendor` package is now in the rosdistro index: https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/76411b71a540fca944856506d9595e506d6c32a7/rolling/distribution.yaml#L4855-L4859.
